dex.entry: A gust-fox kit born on the exposed upper terraces, its tail a perpetual blurred blur of motion that keeps it airborne a fraction of a second longer than it should be able to stay. The fox whose tail moves so fast it looks like it has three tails at once — speed incarnate.

art.silhouette: Compact kit silhouette, deep azure-blue fur, four white paws, a tall pointed ear-fan on each side, a blurred fan-tail of multiple stacked ghost images; looks like it's still mid-run at 32px.
